title: formdesign

catalog.name: FormDesign
catalog.summary: Page layout and PDF work in one app: lay out, publish, read, sign and edit.

notes_for_owner: OWNER: setup/install_core downloads formdesign-core-<triple> from a release named formdesign-v<version> on formcompiler, which no longer exists from formcompiler v0.9.0; the app must read https://github.com/nodemode-dev/formdesign/releases/download/v<version>/ instead. those files come from the desktop artifacts glob src-tauri/binaries/formdesign-core-* (aarch64-apple-darwin, x86_64-apple-darwin, x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe); the macos-x64 build makes the x86_64-apple-darwin core, so the core-macos-x64 extra it replaced is gone. No aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu core is built because no linux-arm64 platform is listed, although install_core accepts that triple. build.tauri_config is empty on purpose: src-tauri/tauri.updater.conf.json only sets createUpdaterArtifacts, which formcompiler adds itself when TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set, and merging it into an unsigned build would make tauri build ask for a key it does not have. The updater public key in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json is still empty, so the app skips update checks until a key pair is made and TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY is set in formcompiler.
